system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the checkpoint coordination protocol. It extends the base checkpoint coordination specification and introduces finite bounds on the natural numbers and log indices to make the state space finite for exhaustive model checking. It also provides a symmetry reduction over nodes and a state constraint. Additionally, it defines an incorrectly optimized version of the lease replacement logic that demonstrates a subtle bug discovered by the model checker.
actors_and_components: Same as the checkpoint coordination specification: a set of replica nodes with one elected leader coordinating checkpoint leases among secondaries. This module adds constants for maximum log depth and maximum natural number value.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the checkpoint coordination specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the checkpoint coordination specification, but with natural numbers and log indices restricted to finite ranges.
actions: Inherits all actions from the checkpoint coordination specification. Additionally defines an incorrectly optimized lease replacement predicate that adds a flawed rule: a lease should also be replaced if the lease holder is the current leader. This optimization is incorrect because it can lead to two nodes simultaneously believing they can take a checkpoint (demonstrated by a 12-step error trace with three nodes).
safety_properties: Checks the type invariant (all variables within their expected domains) and the safety invariant (no concurrent checkpoints, leader never checkpoints, lease consistency) from the base specification. When the incorrectly optimized lease replacement is substituted, the safety invariant is expected to be violated.
model_bounds: Three nodes in the cluster. Majority quorum size is 2. Maximum log depth is 3 entries. Maximum natural number value is 5. The infinite natural number and log index sets are overridden with finite ranges. A state constraint ensures there are always unused log indices remaining. Node symmetry is applied to reduce the state space. The failure configuration substitutes the incorrectly optimized lease replacement predicate to reproduce the known 12-step safety violation.
additional_assumptions: Two configuration files are provided: one for normal safety checking (which should pass) and one that substitutes the incorrect lease replacement optimization (which should find a safety violation). The node set is declared as a symmetry set to reduce redundant state exploration.
